Welcome to Loveland, Colorado – Where Small Town Charm Meets Urban Convenience

Strategically in southern Larimer County, just a short drive from Fort Collins and 46 miles north of Denver, Loveland merges the appeal of small-town living with the amenities of a bigger city. As of 2024, Loveland continues to thrive with a population of 77,000, offering a quality of life that is attractive both to families and young professionals.

Loveland, Colorado: The Sweetheart City

Renowned as 'The Sweetheart City,' Loveland captivates hearts with its annual Valentine re-mailing program, where thousands send and receive specially stamped letters. The city’s romantic spirit is epitomized by the iconic LOVE lock sculpture, a must-visit for couples.

Living in Loveland: A Comprehensive Overview

  • Transportation: Loveland offers excellent connectivity, with easy access to major highways and various local and regional transit options, including bus services to Denver and Fort Collins.
  • Education: The Thompson School District R-2J provides top-notch education from preschool to high school, serving a wide community with 35 schools.
  • Employment: Major employers like Crop Production Services and Hach boost the local economy, providing numerous opportunities for professionals.
  • Recreation and Culture: From the majestic Rocky Mountain National Park to the vibrant arts scene, Loveland is a sanctuary for nature lovers and culture enthusiasts alike.

What's New in Loveland for 2024?

  • Centerra South Development: The Loveland City Council has recently moved forward with the Centerra South project, which promises to bring new residential and commercial opportunities to the area​ (kunc)​.
  • Community Events: The calendar is packed with activities, including Disney on Ice, local comedy shows, and various fundraisers, ensuring that there's always something happening in Loveland​ (Ground News)​.
  • New Business Openings: REI Co-op is set to open a new store in Loveland by summer 2024, enhancing the local retail landscape and providing outdoor enthusiasts with more options​ (Ground News)​.
